detail.longDescription: PH4NTXM was recently featured by iGuru.gr in a technical introduction to the project. The article covers the core idea behind PH4NTXM as a Debian Live environment focused on cybersecurity, privacy and disposable sessions. Thanks to iGuru.gr for taking the time to look into the project and share it with their readers. https:// iguru.gr/ph4ntxm-proto-ellinik o-debian-live-linux-gia-cybersecurity-kai-privacy/ # PH4NTXM # Linux # CyberSecurity # Hacking # Privacy # Pentesting # OpSec # OpenSource # Technology # Research # Greece
